checkout.notConfiguredText: Online payment isn’t enabled yet: no order was created and nothing was charged. Your cart and your details have been kept; you can also contact me directly.

apiErrors.not-configured: The order service is not configured.
apiErrors.network: Unable to reach the order service. Check your connection, then try again.
apiErrors.timeout: The order service is not responding. Try again in a moment.
apiErrors.invalid-request: Some information was rejected by the server. Check the form.
apiErrors.offer-unavailable: A service in your cart is no longer available. Go back to the cart to remove it.
apiErrors.price-changed: The price of a service has changed since you placed this order. Start the order again to see the new amount. No payment was made.
apiErrors.order-expired: This order is more than 24 hours old. Start it again to confirm current prices. No payment was made.
apiErrors.invalid-state: This order can no longer be changed.
apiErrors.not-approved: The payment was not approved in PayPal. Nothing was charged.
apiErrors.paypal-order-mismatch: This payment does not match your order and was refused. Nothing was charged.
apiErrors.env-mismatch: This order was created in test mode and can no longer be paid. Start the order again.
apiErrors.payments-unavailable: Online payment is not available right now. No order was recorded: contact me to order.
apiErrors.payment-unconfirmed: The payment confirmation could not be obtained. Do not pay a second time: check the status below first.
apiErrors.paypal-unreachable: PayPal is not responding right now. No new payment was started. Try again in a few minutes.
apiErrors.paypal-error: PayPal rejected the request. No payment was confirmed. Try again later or contact me.
apiErrors.rate-limited: Too many orders were sent from your connection. Try again in an hour or contact me.
apiErrors.too-many-attempts: Too many payment attempts for this order. Start the order again or contact me.
apiErrors.server: The order service ran into an error. Try again later.
apiErrors.bad-response: Unexpected response from the order service. No payment was made.

checkout.emptyText: Your cart is empty or contains items that can no longer be ordered.
checkout.leadRequest: Enter your details and what you need. No payment is taken now: I’ll then email you the invoice and a PayPal payment link.

requestErrors.invalid: Some information could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
requestErrors.too-fast: Sent too quickly: take a few seconds to review your order, then submit again.
requestErrors.failed: Your order could not be sent. Check your connection and try again, or contact me. Your cart and details are kept.
requestErrors.not-configured: Online ordering isn’t available yet. Contact me to order.

done.title: Order sent
done.thanks: Thank you {{name}}, your order has been received.
done.text: No payment has been taken yet.
done.next: I’ll get back to you at {{email}} with the invoice and a PayPal payment link.
done.keep: Keep this number: you’ll need it for anything related to your order.

text.created: Your order has been recorded for the amount below. Pay with PayPal to confirm it.
text.payment_pending: Approve the payment in the PayPal window. Nothing is charged until the server has confirmed the payment.
text.paid: Thank you! Your payment has been verified and your order is confirmed.
text.payment_failed: The payment didn’t go through and wasn’t collected. You can try again.
text.cancelled: The payment was abandoned and nothing was charged. You can try again below; your cart is kept.

order.priceChanged: The server recalculated the amount using current prices: {{total}}.
order.paypalUnavailable: PayPal couldn’t be loaded (connection or content blocker). Try again later or contact me.
order.paymentErrorPaypal: PayPal reported an error. No payment was confirmed.
order.reviewText: PayPal is reviewing this payment before charging it. Nothing else to do: you can check the status below, and I will contact you as soon as PayPal confirms it.
order.capturing: Confirming the payment with the server… Do not close this page.
order.instrumentDeclined: This payment method was declined. Choose another one in the PayPal window.
order.sandboxText: No real payment will be made. Use a PayPal Developer Sandbox buyer account.
order.receipt: PayPal sends you a receipt by email. I will get back to you at the address provided about the next steps.
order.unconfirmedNote: Your payment may already have gone through: do not pay a second time. Check the status below first.

login.title: Administrator sign-in
login.lead: Access restricted to explicitly authorised accounts.
login.resetLead: Enter your account address. If it matches an account, a reset link will be sent to it.
login.resetSent: If an account matches this address, a password reset email has just been sent.

account.title: Account settings
account.passwordHint: At least 12 characters, with at least 3 kinds among: lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols.
account.passwordDone: Password changed. Sessions open on other devices have been closed.
account.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
account.not-varied: Use at least 3 kinds of characters (lowercase, uppercase, digits, symbols).
account.same: The new password must differ from the current one.
account.emailDone: A confirmation link has been sent to {{email}}. Your login will change once you open it; then sign in again with the new address.
account.emailNote: The administrator role is tied to the account, not the address: it is kept. Your current address will receive a message allowing you to cancel the change.

overview.title: Overview
overview.lead: Signed in as {{email}}. Figures read live from Firestore.
overview.sourceLocalTitle: The public site still shows local content
overview.sourceLocalText: VITE_CONTENT_SOURCE=local is active: changes made here are saved to Firestore, but the public site will only show them once this line is removed from .env.local (and GitHub variables). Import the current content first so nothing is lost.
overview.importText: {{count}} item(s) from the site (src/data) are not in Firestore yet. The import copies them without replacing anything; demo data is not imported.
overview.importConfirmText: {{count}} document(s) will be created in Firestore. An existing document is never replaced.
overview.importDone: Import finished: {{imported}} created, {{skipped}} already present, {{failed}} failed.

list.invalid: Incomplete or invalid document: it does not appear on the site. Open it to fix it.
list.deleteText: This cannot be undone. Its image will also be deleted from Storage if no other content uses it.

cleanup.deleted: The image no longer in use was deleted from Storage.
cleanup.in-use: The previous image is kept: other content uses it.
cleanup.failed: The previous image could not be deleted and remains in Storage (no impact on the site).

form.slugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Suggested from the title; it cannot be changed later.
form.slugLocked: The identifier cannot be changed after creation.
form.dateHint: Used for sorting: most recent first.
form.summary: The form contains errors: fix the highlighted fields.
form.invalid: The document was rejected by validation:
form.notFound: This content does not exist or was deleted.
form.loadFailed: The content could not be loaded.

failed.upload: The image could not be uploaded to Storage. Nothing was changed.
failed.save: Saving to Firestore failed. Nothing was changed.

reasons.permission-denied: Access denied by the security rules (administrator role missing or removed, or session expired). Sign in again.
reasons.unavailable: Firebase cannot be reached. Check your connection, then try again.
reasons.unknown: Unexpected error. Try again; if it persists, check that Storage is enabled (Blaze plan).

errors.slug: Invalid identifier: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only (and not “new”).
errors.slugTaken: This identifier is already used: choose another one.
errors.url: Invalid address: it must start with https:// (or http://).
errors.price: Invalid amount: positive number, at most two decimals (e.g. 149 or 39.90).

image.hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF, 5 MB max. Uploaded to Firebase Storage on save (requires the Blaze plan).
image.pending: New image selected: {{name}}. It will be uploaded when you save.
image.willRemove: The image will be removed when you save.
image.altHint: Describes the image for people who cannot see it (screen readers, image not loaded).

errors.type: Format not accepted: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF.

image.linkHint: Name of a file in this public/ folder (e.g. my-project.webp, no spaces or accents), or a full https:// address. Works without Storage.
image.linkInvalid: Invalid file name: letters, numbers and dashes, no spaces or accents, with the extension (e.g. my-project.webp). Or an https:// address.
image.previewFailed: No image found at this address. Check the path, or push the image to GitHub first.
